description: Saved social search terms for the editorial routine's early-signal scan, grouped into query families with per-family page budgets. Bluesky and Mastodon are collected by scripts/social_collect.py; X is searched by the routine with the queries below. Every query runs newest first over the window since its last checkpoint; drop posts already handled with scripts/seen_posts.py filter. Edit this file to change what the scan looks for; tests/test_social_queries.py checks its shape.

rules.note: No engagement minimum and no CVE-year filter. A family whose budget runs out before the window is covered is marked incomplete in the run report, not silently truncated. catchup (bare CVE) has its own budget so it cannot starve the rarer phrase families.

early_disclosure.label: Early disclosure (contextual)
early_disclosure.note: These terms are common outside security. Keep a post only when it is about a software or hardware security flaw; judge each one in context.

x.combine: Each family is one OR query: X search supports OR and parentheses (tested 2026-11-27), so a family costs one call per page instead of one per term. -is:retweet drops plain reposts; it is not an engagement filter.

queries.query: ("auth bypass" OR "authentication bypass" OR "authorization bypass" OR "account takeover") -is:retweet
("remote code execution" OR "unauthenticated RCE" OR "command injection" OR "SQL injection") -is:retweet
("arbitrary file read" OR "arbitrary file write" OR "path traversal" OR SSRF) -is:retweet
("suspected exploitation" OR "exploitation attempts" OR "actively exploited" OR "in the wild") -is:retweet
("CVE pending" OR "no CVE" OR unpatched OR "vendor notified") (vulnerability OR vuln OR exploit OR flaw OR bug OR security OR CVE OR patch) -is:retweet

bluesky.combine: Bluesky search does not support OR (tested 2026-11-27: '0day OR zeroday' returns nothing), so each term is its own simple query.

mastodon.social.note: Search needs the token (unauthenticated search returns no statuses). Tag timelines are public and include federated posts from infosec.exchange and other servers. #infosec is not in the primary scan: it is high volume and mostly general news.

infosec.exchange.note: Without a token infosec.exchange answers search with no statuses and tag timelines with HTTP 422, so the collector reads its public local timeline and keeps posts that match a family term or a CVE id (tested 2026-11-27).
